name: pboc_get_cgb_yield
description:
Chinese interest rates by term from FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, OECD monthly data): 10y is the long-term government bond yield (IRLTLT01CNM156N), 3m the 3-month interbank rate (IR3TIB01CNM156N), in percent.
Returns: series_code (FRED id), series_id, label, source, observation_count and observations (date, value) oldest first, missing values dropped.
Inputs (none required): bond_term (10y or 3m; default 10y); start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD); recent_periods (1-500; the last N observations; with no dates it looks back N x 45 days); omit all three for the full history.
For the policy (discount) rate use pboc_get_policy_rate; all series: pboc_list_series. Needs a FRED API key (FRED_API_KEY, config fred.api.key); without one the call fails with a message saying so.
Example: {"bond_term": "10y", "recent_periods": 24}
